name: Ogrish War Axe
upgradeable: Malleable to Infectious War Axe Bloody War Axe Destructive War Axe Petrifying War Axe

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus : +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Vengeful
effects.tooltip: Vengeful : When its wielder is hit in battle, this item has a 10% chance to cause him or her to become full of anger and go into a Rage .

effects.name: Humanoid Bane
effects.tooltip: Humanoid Bane 3 : This weapon is attuned specifically to those that walk among us, dealing an additional 3d10 bane damage vs. Humanoids.

effects.name: Gashing
effects.tooltip: Gashing 7 : The edges of this weapon are sharpened beyond belief, dealing an additional 7d6 slashing damage on each critical hit.

effects.name: Malleable
effects.tooltip: Malleable : This item has a magical aura of malleability and can be combined with any item that has the Fusible property to create a new, more powerful fusion of the two items.

flavor_text: The ogres of Droaam dress themselves in heavy armor and wield huge metallic weapons, unlike their more tribal cousins. This war axe is infused with the fury of such well-armed ogre brutes.
tips: Although this is a greataxe... It actually uses the greatsword wield model & swing animation, and thus swings slightly slower than a real greataxe.
